body.says: A board: what one watches at a glance, its widgets laid out to fit the room, each across the columns it spans, a board within a board hosting widgets of its own.

widgets.says: Its widgets in order, each said as a mount is: what it is called (says), the component that draws it (component), the holons it is given (argument) or the way of looking it is given (gathers), its settings, and how many columns it spans, one to three (span).

body.says: A holon that declares the types it takes and draws what it is given, opening space in it where what it holds is drawn in turn by the components that match. It is made of code, or of data: mounts held as its template.

argument.says: What a mount of it is given: one holon, a list of holons, a selection, either, or a way of looking, with the list it gathers; one holon unless it says otherwise.

code.says: The module the interface runs, as JavaScript, for a component made of code.

kinds.says: The kinds of slot it draws in, by their names: full or face.

named.says: Whether it is drawn only where a slot names it, as a widget a board names is, and never found for a slot by itself; it may still be chosen. Not unless it says.

reads.says: The reads it makes of the field beyond what it is handed, by their forms, as holders or instances: what it may look at, said where it can be seen. None unless it says.

says.says: What it draws, in a sentence.

settings.says: The settings it takes from the slot that opens it, each said in prose with its shape, as a type declares its fields; none unless it says.

takes.says: The names of the types whose instances it draws; none means it draws any holon, when nothing closer matches.

template.says: Its mounts, in order, each given what the component itself was given, where it is made of data: the component a mount calls, and the kind of slot it is.

body.says: What a way of looking gathers, placed in time from one key's moment to another's; a widget, drawn where a board names it.

from.says: The key holding the moment each begins.

to.says: The key holding the moment each ends, absent while it runs.

body.says: What one watches at a glance: its widgets, each a slot drawn by the component it names, laid out to fit the room; seen from above, its name and how many widgets it holds.
What a way of looking gathers, counted by the value each holds under a key, as bars, the most first; a widget, drawn where a board names it.

by.says: The key whose value each holon is counted by; its name unless it says.
